_nominations_closed_doc: true since 30 Sep 2026 (Joachim: 96 signatures in the riding, 75 needed). Home: no nominator callout (Volunteer is the hero button), no Become a nominator section, no 75-nominators source; the riding map section follows Priorities. /nominate/ and /fr/nominate/ keep working with a thank-you note (ui.json nominations_closed), noindex, out of the menus, footer and sitemap; no form (the Supabase rpc submit_nominator_signup is untouched). photos._doc: Photo slots. Put a JPG in assets/img/photos/ named <slot>.jpg (e.g. hero.jpg) and set the slot to that file name; null = no photo (the design shows a clean colour panel instead). "joachim-agou-headshot" = Joachim's headshot (build.py headshot(): WebP + JPEG, 400/800/1200, alt 'Joachim Agou'). See README 'Photo slots'.

_headshot_background_second_doc: 30 Sep 2026: Joachim also likes b (Dallas Road) wherever a second photo fits: the About photo slot (photos.about-portrait = joachim-agou-headshot-second, EN+FR) and a second downloadable headshot next to the main one on Media. Not used where it would duplicate the main headshot on the same page. Its CC BY-SA 2.0 credit (with the share-alike note) is in the footer next to the main one's. null = no second headshot.
_headshot_background_doc: 30 Sep 2026: Joachim asked for a real Victoria background instead of the foliage behind his headshot (cutout by rembg isnet-general-use + matting; face untouched). Options a/b/c: files assets/img/joachim-agou-headshot-bg-{a,b,c}-{400,800,1200}.{jpg,webp} (tools/make_headshot.py <composite> joachim-agou-headshot-bg-X). null = original photo (joachim-agou-headshot-*). Joachim picked c (Parliament / Inner Harbour, blurred) on 30 Sep 2026 and approved it for live. While headshot_background_approved is false, live builds are refused. Only the chosen option ships (build.py removes the other bg files from dist). OG card: og-joachim-agou-photo-bg-c-{en,fr}.jpg (tools/make_og.py). The footer carries the licence credit of the chosen background (build.py bg_credit).

social._doc: Only account URLs that appear in Notion (home page Contact block). Do not add guessed handles.

_promote_donate_doc: ONE-LINE SWITCH. false = Donate is a quiet item inside Get involved only (people are sent to Bert Chen). true = adds a yellow Donate button in the header and in the phone's bottom bar, and a yellow Donate button on the Get involved page. Rebuild after changing.

updated._doc: 'Last updated' date shown on each page (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific time). Notion pages: tools/notion2md.py sets en-<key>/fr-<key> from Notion's page_last_edited_at. Pages built from the home page use the home date. Others: set by hand when you change their text.

_publish_faq_live_doc: false = the live build (build.py --env live) leaves out /faq/ and /fr/faq/ and every link to them (footer, How to vote, Get involved, home 'Questions?' section). Staging always shows the FAQ. Set to true once the FAQ has no [TO COMPLETE] notes left (the live build refuses to run while any remain), rebuild live and publish.
_publish_scorecard_live_doc: Scorecard (/scorecard/, /fr/scorecard/; see scorecard.json and README 'Scorecard'). false = the live build leaves both pages out, with every link to them (Priorities, home priorities section, footer); staging always shows them. Set true only after Joachim approves the page. The live build still refuses to run while scorecard.json has any open fact-check flag or fr_reviewed is false.
_publish_province_live_doc: 'What the Province actually controls' (/province/, /fr/province/; province.py, content/<lang>/province.md, not from Notion; see RESYNC.md). false = the live build leaves both pages out, with every link to them (menu under Priorities, Priorities line, scorecard 'How this page works', footer, sitemap); staging always shows them. Set true only after Joachim approves the page. province_fr_reviewed: false = /fr/province/ shows the 'Traduction provisoire' banner and the live build refuses to run while publish_province_live is true.
_media_kit_doc: Media-kit PDFs in assets/media/ (not from Notion; the Notion PDF attachments are replaced by <placeholder>MEDIAKIT</placeholder> in exclusions.json, and build.py renders that token as the download links). Staging always shows them. publish_media_kit_live: false = the live build keeps the placeholder text, leaves the PDFs out of dist/ and fails if any page links to them. true = live shows the links, but the live build still refuses to run if pdftotext finds forbidden wording or an unlisted phone number in a PDF.
